backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: Download a JSON copy of accounts, operations, plans, rates, and settings. Restore replaces the current database.
backup.scopeNote: The file is financial D1 data only. Passkeys, sessions, and OAuth/MCP auth are not included — they live on this instance; the Passkey private key stays on the device.
backup.restoreWarning: This overwrite cannot be undone. Accounts, operations, planned items, recurring rules, rates, and settings will be replaced with the file contents. Passkeys, MCP clients, and receipt files in storage are not in the backup.
backup.fileInvalid: This file is not a Money Flow backup

reset.title: Reset
reset.hint: Wipe accounts, operations, plans, rates, and settings to an empty instance. No redeploy.
reset.scopeNote: Passkeys, sessions, and OAuth/MCP clients stay on this instance. Receipt files in storage are not deleted.
reset.confirmWarning: This cannot be undone. Accounts, operations, planned items, recurring rules, rates, and ledger settings will be deleted. Passkeys, MCP clients, and receipt files in storage stay.

receipts.empty: No fiscal receipts yet. Finance writes the PFR to fiscal_receipt_id; a verify URL stays in receipt_url.

errors.NO_PATCH_FIELDS: Provide at least one known field to update
errors.CONCURRENT_UPDATE: The record changed concurrently; refresh and try again
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is already used by operations, planned items, or recurring rules — owner, currency, country, bank, and type can no longer change. Create a new account and move the balance
errors.ACCOUNT_IN_USE: This account is used by operations, planned items, or recurring payments — change those first or archive the account
errors.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_CHANGE_REQUIRES_BALANCE: Changing currency changes the meaning of the balance — send balance_minor in the new currency in the same request
errors.ACCOUNTS_MUST_DIFFER: Source and destination accounts must be different
errors.QUERY_REQUIRED: Query parameter q (source account) is required
errors.ACCOUNT_ID_REQUIRED: account_id is required and must be a number
errors.ALIAS_TEXT_REQUIRED: alias_text is required and cannot be empty
errors.ALIAS_ALREADY_BOUND: This alias is already bound to an account
errors.ALIAS_NOT_FOUND: Alias not found on this account
errors.PENDING_ACCOUNT_RESOLVED: Unknown account is already processed or does not exist
errors.CURRENCY_CODE_INVALID: Currency code must be exactly three Latin letters (ISO 4217), for example USD
errors.BASE_CURRENCY_RATE_FORBIDDEN: A USD rate is not needed: all rates are stored as usd_per_unit, so 1 USD = 1 USD by definition. Delete the row if it already exists
errors.RATE_REQUIRED: Send the rate in the rate field
errors.RATE_INVALID: Invalid FX rate "{{value}}" — expected a non-negative decimal with at most nine fraction digits, no exponent, and no sign
errors.RATE_TOO_LARGE: Rate is too large — check that the conversion direction is not reversed
errors.RATE_IN_USE: Currency {{code}} is used by accounts or operations — their amounts cannot be converted without a rate. Change the currency on those rows or delete them first
errors.PLANNED_ITEM_STALE: The planned item changed after confirmation; request a new confirmation
errors.PLANNED_ITEM_ALREADY_FULFILLED: The planned item is already fulfilled by another financial fact
errors.PLANNED_ITEM_ALREADY_DONE_UNLINKED: The planned item is already marked done without an available link
errors.PLANNED_ITEM_LINKED_FACT: The planned item is linked to an independent financial fact; reopen it before changing: {{fields}}
errors.PLANNED_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: A planned item can be marked done only when its currency matches the account currency ({{accountCurrency}}); it is currently {{plannedCurrency}}
errors.TRANSFER_CANNOT_FULFILL_PLANNED: A transfer cannot fulfill a planned item
errors.OPERATION_ALREADY_CLAIMED: The operation already fulfills another expectation
errors.OPERATIONS_NOT_FOUND: One or more operations were not found
errors.OPERATIONS_ALREADY_CLAIMED: One or more operations already fulfill another expectation
errors.OPERATION_LINKED_EXPECTATION: The operation is linked to an expectation; unlink it before changing: {{fields}}
errors.OPERATION_FULFILLS_RECURRING: The operation fulfills a recurring occurrence of rule ID {{recurringItemId}}; cancel that period fulfillment first
errors.FULFILLMENT_CONFLICT: The operation or planned item was linked concurrently
errors.FULFILLMENT_KIND_MISMATCH: Operation kind does not match the planned or recurring item
errors.FULFILLMENT_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: Operation account does not match the planned or recurring item
errors.FULFILLMENT_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: Operation currency does not match the planned or recurring item
errors.FULFILLMENT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH: Operation amount does not match the planned item
errors.FULFILLMENT_DATE_MISMATCH: Operation date does not match the planned or recurring item
errors.FULFILLMENT_CATEGORY_MISMATCH: Operation category does not match the planned or recurring item
errors.FULFILLMENT_SIGN_MISMATCH: Operation sign does not match the recurring rule
errors.FULFILLMENT_EVIDENCE_AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The operation group total does not match the recurring rule amount × evidence_quantity
errors.RECURRING_ITEM_STALE: The recurring rule changed after confirmation; request a new confirmation
errors.RECURRING_ITEM_INACTIVE_CLOSE: An inactive recurring rule cannot be closed
errors.RECURRING_ITEM_INACTIVE_FULFILL: An inactive recurring rule cannot be fulfilled
errors.RECURRING_ITEM_INACTIVE_SKIP: An inactive recurring rule cannot be advanced
errors.RECURRING_PERIOD_ALREADY_CLOSED: This recurring-rule period is already closed
errors.RECURRING_OCCURRENCE_ALREADY_FULFILLED: This recurring occurrence already has another fulfillment
errors.RECURRING_PERIOD_MISMATCH: period_due_date does not match the current recurring-rule occurrence
errors.RECURRING_PERIOD_ALREADY_RESOLVED: This recurring-rule period is already fulfilled or skipped
errors.RECURRING_PERIOD_FULFILLMENT_NOT_FOUND: No recurring period fulfillment exists for this rule and date
errors.ANALYTICAL_RECURRING_SKIP_ONLY: Analytical recurring rule {{recurringItemId}} accepts skip_period only
errors.DUPLICATE_EXPENSE: This expense looks like a duplicate of operation {{existingOperationId}}
errors.TRANSFER_CANNOT_FULFILL_RECURRING: A transfer cannot fulfill a recurring occurrence
errors.RECURRING_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: A period can be closed only when the rule currency matches the account currency ({{accountCurrency}}); it is currently {{ruleCurrency}}
errors.RECURRING_END_BEFORE_NEXT: end_date cannot be earlier than next_due_date
errors.TRANSFER_CORRUPT: Transfer is corrupt — exactly two operations are required
errors.TRANSFER_VIA_OPERATIONS_FORBIDDEN: Create a transfer via /api/v2/transfers, not directly via /operations
errors.TRANSFER_FIELDS_ATOMIC: Transfer amount, account, and kind cannot be changed separately — delete the transfer and create it again
errors.TRANSFER_FROM_CURRENCY_CHANGE_REQUIRES_A: Changing the account changes the debit currency from {{fromCurrency}} to {{toCurrency}} — send from_amount_minor in the new currency
errors.TRANSFER_TO_CURRENCY_CHANGE_REQUIRES_AMO: Changing the account changes the credit currency from {{fromCurrency}} to {{toCurrency}} — send to_amount_minor in the new currency
errors.CURRENCY_CHANGE_REQUIRES_AMOUNT: Changing currency changes the meaning of the amount — send amount_minor in the new currency in the same request
errors.AMOUNT_MUST_BE_NEGATIVE: {{kind}} decreases the balance — amount_minor must be negative
errors.AMOUNT_MUST_BE_POSITIVE: {{kind}} increases the balance — amount_minor must be positive
errors.FIELD_TYPE_STRING_OR_NULL: {{field}} must be a string or null
errors.FIELD_TYPE_INTEGER_MINOR: {{field}} must be an integer in minor currency units
errors.FIELD_NOT_ZERO: {{field}} cannot be zero — an operation without an amount is meaningless
errors.INVALID_ISO_DATE: {{field}} is required and must be a YYYY-MM-DD string
errors.INVALID_CURRENCY: currency must be exactly three Latin letters (ISO 4217), for example USD
errors.INVALID_SORT: sort must be an integer within ±1 000 000 000
errors.INVALID_KIND: kind is required and must be one of: {{values}}
errors.INVALID_FREQUENCY: frequency is required and must be one of: {{values}}
errors.INVALID_INTERVAL_COUNT: interval_count must be an integer from 1 to 365
errors.INVALID_RANGE: {{field}} must be an integer from {{min}} to {{max}} or omitted
errors.INVALID_RECEIPT_URL: receipt_url must be an http or https URL of at most 4096 characters
errors.INVALID_FISCAL_RECEIPT_ID: fiscal_receipt_id must be at most 128 characters (PFR / fiscal document id; do not put it in item)
errors.SUBCATEGORY_REQUIRES_CATEGORY: subcategory without category is meaningless — set a category or remove the subcategory
errors.SOURCE_NOT_SETTABLE: source cannot be set here: this API only creates manual or agent operations (source = "manual" or "agent")
errors.RECEIPT_ID_NOT_SETTABLE: receipt_id cannot be set here: receipt lines are created by receipt parsing (S2), not manual entry
errors.PLANNED_ITEM_ID_NOT_SETTABLE: planned_item_id cannot be set here: marking a plan done creates the operation
errors.RECURRING_ITEM_ID_NOT_SETTABLE: recurring_item_id cannot be set here: closing a period creates the operation
errors.TRANSFER_ID_NOT_SETTABLE: transfer_id cannot be set here: create a transfer via /api/v2/transfers
errors.FREQUENCY_DAY_FORBIDDEN: day_of_month must be empty for daily/weekly frequency — those rules have no day of month
errors.FREQUENCY_MONTH_FORBIDDEN: month_of_year must be empty for daily/weekly frequency
errors.FREQUENCY_MONTH_YEARLY_ONLY: month_of_year must be empty for monthly frequency — only yearly rules have it
errors.FREQUENCY_MONTH_DERIVED: A yearly rule month_of_year is taken from next_due_date (month {{month}}) — send a matching value or omit it
errors.OPERATION_IDS_INVALID: operation_ids must be a non-empty array of at most 100 IDs
errors.DAYS_INVALID: days must be an integer from 1 to 366
errors.SETTING_CURRENCY_INVALID: value must be a valid ISO 4217 currency code
errors.DATE_RANGE_INVALID: start_date cannot be later than end_date
errors.REQUEST_BODY_INVALID: Request body must be a JSON object
errors.PASSKEY_CONFIRM_LAST: This is the last active passkey. The next sign-in will require your SETUP_TOKEN. Confirm the action
errors.PASSKEY_NOT_REGISTERED: No passkey is registered — start with /setup/passkey
errors.STEP_UP_REQUIRED: Confirm with an existing passkey or SETUP_TOKEN before changing login factors
errors.OAUTH_REVOKE_FAILED: Could not revoke the OAuth grant in provider storage — the token was not marked revoked
errors.OAUTH_GRANT_RECORD_FAILED: Could not record the OAuth grant — authorization was cancelled
errors.FILTER_ITEM_TOO_LONG: Analytics filter value is too long
errors.BALANCE_OUT_OF_SAFE_RANGE: The resulting balance is outside the safe integer range
errors.LEDGER_EFFECT_MISSING: The financial mutation did not apply its ledger effect
errors.AMOUNT_OUT_OF_SAFE_RANGE: Monetary total “{{field}}” is outside the safe integer range
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests — try again later
errors.CSRF_ORIGIN_INVALID: Request origin is not the application origin
errors.LOGOUT_REVOKE_FAILED: Could not revoke the session — try again
errors.BACKUP_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Restore replaces all user data — send confirm: true after the UI warning
errors.BACKUP_FORMAT_INVALID: Not a Money Flow v2 backup file
errors.BACKUP_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: This backup version is not supported
errors.BACKUP_TABLE_INVALID: Backup table “{{table}}” is missing or not an array
errors.BACKUP_ROW_INVALID: Backup row {{index}} in {{table}} has an invalid {{field}}
errors.RESET_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Reset wipes all financial data — send confirm: true after the UI warning
errors.RESET_PHRASE_REQUIRED: Type RESET to confirm wiping all financial data
errors.DEMO_PASSKEY_DISABLED: Passkey enrollment is disabled on the public demo
